decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the approved drawings, no windows or associated joinery shall be removed or altered until a detailed condition survey and schedule of repair, upgrade (including secondary glazing) and replacement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Where windows are demonstrably beyond reasonable repair, additional drawings that show details of proposed new windows by section and elevation at a scales of between 1:20 and 1:1 as appropriate shall be submitted. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and permanently maintained as such.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

MethodologiesPrior to the removal of existing cementitious render a method statement outlining the approach to the removal of render and 'making good' existing brickworks shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The method statement shall be accompanied by a sample area no greater than 450x450mm which shall be made available for inspection. The works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved method statement and sample panel.Prior to the commencement of relevant works, proposals for the method and extent of repointing shall be approved in writing with the Local Planning Authority and be carried out accordingly.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

No cleaning of masonry, other than low pressure (20-100 psi) surface cleaning using a nebulous water spray and/or Doff steam clean is authorised by this consent without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority. Before work begins, any other cleaning proposals must be approved in writing and carried out strictly in accordance with those details. At the commencement of the cleaning, a test panel shall be undertaken in an inconspicuous position and the method recorded to the approval of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

Minor Electrical AdditionsPrior to installation, details of all CCTV, external lighting and entry systems (including associated wiring) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and permanently maintained as such.Reason: To safeguard the special architectural or historic interest, character, appearance and integrity of the Listed building

The works approved by this Listed Building Consent must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this decision notice. Reason: To comply with S.51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

No demolition or development shall take place until a written scheme of investigation (WSI) has been submitted to and approved by the local planning authority in writing. For land that is included within the WSI, no demolition or development shall take place other than in accordance with the agreed WSI, which shall include the statement of significance and research objectives, andA. The programme and methodology of site investigation and recording and the nomination of a competent person(s) or organisation to undertake the agreed worksB. Where appropriate, details of a programme for delivering related positive public benefitsC. The programme for post-investigation assessment and subsequent analysis, publication & dissemination and deposition of resulting material.This part of the condition shall not be discharged until these elements have been fulfilled in accordance with the programme set out in the WSIReason: To ensure adequate opportunity is provided for archaeological research on this historically important site.

MaterialsPrior to their use, samples of the materials to be used on the external finishes - with the exception of tile cladding - shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and permanently maintained as such.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

MaterialsPrior to their use, a sample panel of 1 square metre minimum shall be erected on site to show areas of new, exterior walling, and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These panels shall indicate tile size, colour, texture and bond together with mortar mix, joint size and profile. Upon approval the sample panels shall be retained on site for reference for the duration of works unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority. The works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

Access GatePrior to insertion, additional drawings that show details of proposed new entrance gate by section and elevation at scales between 1:20 and 1:1 as appropriate shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.Reason: To safeguard the special architectural or historic interest, character, appearance and integrity of the Listed building.

External DecorationPrior to the commencement of relevant works, details of external decoration together with a schedule of works to conserve the lamp bracket, statue, entrance canopy and date stone shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

Roof AppurtenancesPrior to the commencement of works to the roof, large scale details of rooftop appurtenances including rooflights shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

Prior to the commencement of works to the roof, large scale details of rooftop appurtenances including the proposed solar panels shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

Prior to the commencement of works to the roof, large scale details of rooftop appurtenances including vents and air-handling unit (including associated screen) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such. Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

Storage of FeaturesPrior to the commencement of works, a method statement for the long term storage of removed historic features shall be submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The method statement shall; identify the items to be removed; detail arrangements for temporary secure storage through construction; and provide details on the location of long-term storage together with measures to safeguard their retention and conservation.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

Notwithstanding the approved plans, permission is not granted for the replacement of 'DG10' as shown on approved plan 'Works to Doors and plans with window and door numbers' Drawing No.:247_S_012 Rev: B Date 26/06/2024. Prior to relevant works commencing, a full schedule of works required to this doorway shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.Informative: There is a strong presumption for the existing door to be retained and re-used. Any deviation from this will require clear and convincing justification.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

Internal works shall not be commenced until a schedule of repair, together with details of all new, internal surfaces (including walls, ceilings and floors), internal joinery (including doors, staircase, shutters, cupboards and panelling) and historic features (including fireplaces) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. This shall include the proposed finish and decoration to be used. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

No additional insulation shall be introduced until additional drawings that show details by section and elevation at scales between 1:20 and 1:1 as appropriate shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Details shall be informed by an analysis of existing fabric and show junctions with existing features including windows, shutters, doors, skirtings and other joinery. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

Building RecordingNo demolition or conversion shall commence until a programme of historic building recording has been secured in accordance with a written scheme of investigation which has been submitted by the applicant, and approved by the planning authority.The applicant will submit to the local planning authority an approved historic building report (to be submitted within six months of the completion of fieldwork, unless otherwise agreed in advance with the Planning Authority in consultation with the Greater London Archaeology Advice Service). This report shall be submitted to the Greater London Historic Environment Record and Local Studies Library in accordance with their guidelines and best practice.The purpose of this condition is to ensure that the comprehensive research and analysis already undertaken is formally added to the GLHER. The WSI shall detail what information is to be submitted, when it will be submitted, and what format it will be submitted. Additional recording and research will only be necessary if hereto unknown historic features are revealed following the commencement of works.Reason: To safeguard the identification and recording of any features of architectural, historic and archaeological interest associated with the site and the fabric of the building.

Prior to the commencement of relevant works, details of external air grille vents and rainwater good details with product literature shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Works shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and shall be permanently maintained as such.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until  a Lighting Strategy (LS) has first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.Reason: in order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.
description: Conversion of school building and headmistress cottage into a community facility and training centre for students with special education needs, involving single storey rear extensions at west elevation for new accessible entrance, toilets and plant room, at east for a cafe, dining area,, together with reinstating sash windows to cottage and meeting room, re roof hall and cottage with solar panels to east and west of hall and west of new extension, raising of roof to meeting room, install 2x glass bay lantern windows outside the south hall windows, reconstruction of link between hall and meeting room for lifts and stairs, mechanical plant to flat roof of link,  intake ducts to roof of east extension with air handling unit for the cafe, rear terrace, reconstruction of east garden boundary wall, demolition of toilet block, with pollard 3x existing Sycamore trees.
